CONCEPT ILLUSTRATION · NOT A PRODUCT SCREENSHOT

PROJECT 01 / FLAGSHIP · IN DEVELOPMENT

AVENAdaptive Intelligence for Student Learning

A student-only learning platform I’m building around one continuous loop: study, practise, measure mastery, revisit weak areas—and adapt.

REACT + TYPESCRIPTNODE.JSPOSTGRESQLQDRANT
BUILT SO FAR

Quizzes, private study materials, semantic retrieval, mastery and retention tracking, and spaced-repetition flashcards.

Inside the learning system +

Practice and exam modes use server-authoritative timing and scoring, with results, history and leaderboards. An adaptive student model tracks topic-level mastery, accuracy, confidence, performance trends and retention to guide practice.

Uploaded PDF, TXT and Markdown materials are extracted, structured and chunked. BGE-small-en-v1.5 produces 384-dimensional embeddings for Qdrant retrieval with student-level isolation. Flashcards use SM-2 spaced repetition.

React, TypeScript and Tailwind power the interface; Node.js, Express and PostgreSQL support the backend. Argon2id authentication, server-managed sessions and academic-profile-based curriculum eligibility provide the foundation.

Next: the AVEN AI Core +

The AI Gateway and provider abstraction are in place. A working production LLM provider is not yet integrated; Gemini is the first candidate to test.

The next phase connects contextual teaching, document-grounded quizzes and flashcards, and study-material generation to permission-checked backend tools. Generated content must pass deterministic validation before creating anything inside AVEN. Scoring, mastery, retention and database changes remain controlled by the application.

PROJECT 02 / WORKSHOP PROJECT

One plan.
Multiple perspectives.

SmartStudy combines sequential, parallel and loop agents to turn a student’s requirements into a reviewed study plan.

PYTHONGOOGLE ADKMULTI-AGENT
How it works +

A coordinator and planning agent prepare the brief. Three specialists analyze topics, practice and scheduling in parallel. A writer combines their outputs, followed by a review-and-revision loop of up to two iterations. Built for the “Beyond Chatbots” workshop assignment.
